Content.value: GIFT City · India's International Financial Services Centre
Where India meets the world's capital.
GIFT City is home. One gateway for global investors, funds, banks and businesses to access India, and for Indians to invest around the world.
A global financial hub, built in India.

GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City) hosts India's first International Financial Services Centre. It lets funds, banks, insurers and businesses operate in a globally benchmarked environment, regulated by a single unified regulator, IFSCA.
Watch the presentation to see how it works, who it is for and why it matters.
Built for everyone in the ecosystem.
Choose who you are to see what GIFT City offers you.
From a bold idea to a thriving international financial centre.
Inbound and outbound funds available through GIFT City.
